source.description:
## PROBLEM

Same shape as B3 but for xtrm-tools .xtrm/debug.db (Claude Code + Pi runtime + hooks). Per B2 taxonomy, teach every emit site to dual-write a xtrm.forensic.v1 envelope.

## SUCCESS

- New table forensic_events in .xtrm/debug.db alongside events
- Every hook emit site writes both legacy row and forensic row
- Correlation-block populated: session_id, bead_id, tool_name, runtime (claude-code|pi|codex)
- Legacy xt debug CLI unchanged; regression suite passes
- Feature flag: XTRM_DEBUG_FORENSIC_EMIT=on|off

## SCOPE

- xtrm-tools/core: cli/src/core/emit-event.ts (or wherever events flow), all hook payload writers under .xtrm/hooks/ that persist events
- cli/src/commands/debug.ts — no change (still reads legacy table)
- New migration for .xtrm/debug.db (or programmatic table create; check how xt debug bootstraps its DB)

## NON_GOALS

- Do not remove legacy events table (B5).
- Do not migrate historical events.
- Do not touch policies/*.json (hook wiring).

## CONSTRAINTS

- Dual-write atomic; legacy write is authoritative during migration.
- SCRUTINY: high.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Every emit site swept and verified dual-writing
- [ ] Vitest: envelope conforms to schema
- [ ] Integration: run a Claude Code session, assert forensic_events populated with matching entries
- [ ] Regression: xt debug shows identical events; npm test --workspace cli passes
- [ ] Smoke: xt log --source xtrm --bead <recent> returns forensic events

## LIBRARIES

- **Reuse in repo:** cli/src/commands/debug.ts (existing schema), cli/src/core/ (emit utils)
- **Installed deps:** better-sqlite3
- **Stdlib:** n/a
- **New dep candidate:** none
- **Roll it:** yes

## OUTPUT

New table + emitter changes + migration + tests + regression pass.
source.title: B4: xt debug emitter refactor — dual-emit legacy + xtrm.forensic.v1
